content.test_md_blob:
# Review recent activity status pill rendering

> Prove visible recent-activity statuses are rendered as compact pill-style labels.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in the browser and arrive at the dashboard view that contains the full-width Recent Activity section.

## Step 2

In the Recent Activity table, inspect each visible STATUS cell for the rows currently shown in the feed.

## Step 3

Assert every visible STATUS value is shown inside a compact pill-style badge rather than as plain uncontained text.

## Step 4 — assert @verifies ac-117

Confirm presence check: every visible STATUS value is shown inside a compact pill-style badge (forall) — the stated promise: Each displayed status is rendered as a pill-style label in the STATUS column.
